title: Electric Charges and Fields - Sample Set 1
subject: Physics

questions.question: The SI unit of electric charge is:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of electric charge is coulomb (C).

questions.question: The force between two point charges varies inversely as:
questions.explanation: Coulomb's law states that the electrostatic force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance between the charges.
